text:
anna-marketing: Quick sync — final preflight for the webinar landing. Need: KW mapping, JSON-LD (Event + FAQ), internal anchors, redirects CSV, and GA event wiring. Can we close today?

ben-seo: I'll push a prioritized KW list (intent | mid | product) and suggested H1/H2 placements. Seed phrases: "inference cost", "production latency", "dedicated inference". Also will add `rel=canonical` guidance.

chris-growth: Two CTAs to A/B test: Variant A = "See benchmark results" (bench narrative) Variant B = "Get early access" (product). Different UTMs and TY pages.

dana-analytics: Event spec: `webinar_signup` with labels `cta_variant` and `kw_group`. Test steps: submit both variants, confirm GA debug and server-side logs. I'll add a short sim for CTRs.

emily-ops: Slug rules: ASCII only, hyphens, <=64 chars. Redirects must be 301 unless temporary. Add CSV to PR. CI will lint slugs.

ben-seo: Draft redirect rows (append to redirects.csv):
```
/old-inference-blog,/launch/production-inference,301,intent=benchmark
/beta-signup,/webinar/prod-inference,301,intent=signup
/promo-seed,/webinar/seed-kw,302,intent=kw-capture
```
I'll include an `intent` column so marketing can filter campaign redirects.

anna-marketing: Internal anchors: 3 in-post anchors -> product page, docs quickstart, webinar signup. Anchor text should use top KW variants. Keep it minimal to avoid dilution.

chris-growth: I'll draft microcopy for both CTAs + headline variants by EOD.

dana-analytics: Running sim now, will paste numbers in the sheet and the test checklist.

emily-ops: Opening PR now and will add CSV + slug lint. Staging preview will include `data-intent` attributes on CTA buttons.

webinar-bot: Reminder — Webinar "Production Inference Economics" Thu 11/2. Staging preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/webinar/prod-inference-preview

anna-marketing: Action items: @ben-seo KW list + JSON-LD, @chris-growth CTA variants + UTMs, @dana-analytics events + sim, @emily-ops PR with redirects. I'll run final preflight when done. :rocket:
